```tok
tok 1.0 "MPON process"

pool org "Organisation"
  lane mpon "MPON"
    start s "Start"
    task r "MPON reports the meter operation to the GO"
    task mf "MPON informs the GO about the failure of the entire process"
    task ms "MPON informs the GO about the successful completion of the entire process"
    task m_acq "MPON performs the equipment acquisition and/or equipment changes"
  lane go "GO"
    task e "GO examines the application of the MPON"
    xor d1 "Application approved?"
    task rej "GO rejects the application of the MPON"
    task conf "GO confirms the application of the MPON"
    and g1 "Inform registration split"
    task imr "GO informs the MPOO about the registration confirmation of the MPON"
    task isr "GO informs the MSPO about the registration confirmation of the MPON"
    and g2 "Inform registration join"
    and a1 "Acquisition split"
    and a2 "Acquisition join"
    xor d2 "MPON informs GO outcome"
    task cfa "GO confirms the failure of the assignment to the MPON"
    and fsplit "Failure inform split"
    task imfa "GO informs the MPOO about the failure of the assignment of the MPON"
    task isfa "GO informs the MSPO about the failure of the assignment of the MPON"
    and fjoin "Failure inform join"
    task assign "GO assigns the MPON"
    task cassign "GO confirms the assignment to the MPON"
    and asplit "Assignment inform split"
    task ima "GO informs the MPOO about the assignment of the MPON"
    task isa "GO informs the MSPO about the assignment of the MPON"
    task isp "GO informs the SP about the assignment of the MPON"
    and ajoin "Assignment inform join"
    end end_success "Process completed successfully"
    end end_failure "Process failed"
    end end_reject "Application rejected"
    start timeout "Timeout waiting for MPON" timer=PT48H
    task tinfo "GO informs the MPON about the failure of the overall transaction"
    end end_timeout "Overall transaction timed out"
  lane mpoo "MPOO"
    task p_acq "MPOO performs the equipment acquisition and/or equipment changes"
  lane msppo "MSPO"
    # no dedicated tasks (receives are performed by GO)
  lane sp "SP"
    # no dedicated tasks (receives are performed by GO)

flow s -> r -> e -> d1
flow d1 -> rej
flow d1 -> conf
flow rej -> end_reject
flow conf -> g1
flow g1 -> imr
flow g1 -> isr
flow imr -> g2
flow isr -> g2
flow g2 -> a1
flow a1 -> m_acq
flow a1 -> p_acq
flow m_acq -> a2
flow p_acq -> a2
flow a2 -> d2
flow d2 -> mf
flow d2 -> ms
flow mf -> cfa -> fsplit
flow fsplit -> imfa
flow fsplit -> isfa
flow imfa -> fjoin
flow isfa -> fjoin
flow fjoin -> end_failure
flow ms -> assign -> cassign -> asplit
flow asplit -> ima
flow asplit -> isa
flow asplit -> isp
flow ima -> ajoin
flow isa -> ajoin
flow isp -> ajoin
flow ajoin -> end_success
flow timeout -> tinfo -> end_timeout
```
